title: The World Waking Up

video_prompt.background_elements: Rooster crowing in distance, swaying palm shadows on the wall, framed family photo, school bag hanging near the bed, subtle dust particles sparkling in sunlight
video_prompt.camera_movement: Slow cinematic push-in from wide bedroom view toward her face, ending in close-up with soft sunlight lens flare crossing frame

video_prompt.color_grade: Warm amber, sunrise gold, soft white highlights with pastel village tones
